name: Tali Ross
life: “I still remember recognizing a coat even when I couldn't see its owner.” On Tuesday, near the brick passage off the shop row, Tali takes the longer way when the smell from the ovens reaches the pavement.
voice: I work the courthouse door and recognize that coat from its owner's weekly jury-duty arguments.
appearance: Tali has short sandy hair and a marked widow's peak, a scattering of freckles across the bridge of the nose, and a favorite piece of clothing, a dark green knitted vest. It usually goes with a folded shopping list secured by a miniature clip. When somebody else has the floor, Tali looks at people's hands before looking at what they carry.
personality: Tali carries anger into a conversation very slowly. Once it arrives, a quiet statement of facts can be considerably harder to sidestep than a shout.
agenda: To let the two men collect the coat privately.
family: Georgia Myers is Tali’s stepsibling. Tali asks what the birthday guest would like this year. Georgia remembers the birthdays. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *A tenant who stays*, Georgia says, “I build tiny flats. I priced an addition and told everyone whose window it would shadow.”
connections: Julian Kapoor. The insurance assessor and court worker recognize different parts of the claimant's history.

reactions.situation: The borrower wants to return the coat before the hearing
reactions.response: Tali checks whether the borrower has something suitable to wear through the hearing.

reactions.situation: A coworker arrives late after a night at the hospital
reactions.response: Tali takes one immediate task off their hands and asks when they want to tell the supervisor.
